basic_info.description: This spacious, remodeled home is located on a tree-lined street in the Sunset one block from Golden Gate Park. A lovely, tiled exterior staircase leads to the main level which consists of a tiled entry foyer with original glass double doors, an elegant stairway with wood trim & original character, a bright living room with gas fireplace insert and built-in cabinets, a wood-paneled formal dining room with beautiful built-in cabinets, a remodeled powder room, and a large, remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances including Wolf gas range, under-counter wine refrigerator, Sub-Zero refrigerator, drawer microwave, and dishwasher. Adjacent to the kitchen, a sliding glass door leads to the rear deck and stairs to the lovely garden. On the upper level, there are three bright bedrooms, one en-suite, and two full, remodeled baths. The lower level includes storage rooms, one car garage, laundry area, & access to the spacious, mature garden. Shops & Golden Gate Park both within walking distance.
